segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. How can I help?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Hi Maya, yeah, this is Daniel at North Ridge Supply. I just need a copy of our June invoice and to make sure the billing contact is changed to our new AP inbox.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Sure, I can help with that. Can you confirm the account name and the last four digits of the payment method on file?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Account is North Ridge Supply, and the card ends in 4429.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Perfect, thank you. I’m pulling it up in the billing tool now. I see invoice 31874 for June, total is $2,184.00, issued June 3rd. Is that the one you need?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that’s the one. And the new email should be ap@northridgesupply.com. The old one was going to Melissa, and she moved teams.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. I’ve updated the billing contact to ap@northridgesupply.com and sent invoice 31874 to that address. You should see it in a couple minutes.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Can you also keep Melissa as an admin in the product, just not on billing?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yes, no change to her admin access. I’m only updating the billing contact in the billing tool. Product users stay as they are.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: All set. I’ll also note this on ticket 74216 in case your team asks later. Thanks for calling.
